title: ETHICAL Farm-To-Press SOURCING
body: We hand-select only mature, sunshine-ripened sugarcane grown without chemical ripeners. Pressed the traditional way on cold brass rolls to preserve all natural vitamins, live enzymes, and authentic sweetness.

pillars.title: Hand-Selected Mature Stalks
pillars.desc: Harvested at peak Brix sweetness from sustainable farms with thick juicy fibers.

pillars.title: Traditional Cold Extraction
pillars.desc: Slow, cold mechanical brass-roller pressing to keep live enzymes and alkaline minerals alive.

pillars.title: 100% Pure — Zero Added Sugar
pillars.desc: Unpasteurized, unadulterated raw nectar served naturally chilled with no water dilution.
